### 1 — Scene
A mixed dinner plate with breaded fried chicken, Caesar-style salad, broccoli, and a small cheese-and-tomato pizza portion at the top.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **27 cm across**. Using an equivalent circular diameter of **28 cm**, its area is approximately **615 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas are estimates of the food’s footprint. Dressing coats the salad, so it adds volume and weight but no separate footprint.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Romaine lettuce | 30% | 185 cm² × 3 cm = 555 ml | 0.15 | 83 g | 17 | 14 kcal |
| Croutons | 2% | 12 cm² × 1.8 cm = 22 ml | 0.30 | 7 g | 400 | 28 kcal |
| Parmesan shavings | 1% | 6 cm² × 0.35 cm = 2 ml | 1.0 | 2 g | 420 | 8 kcal |
| Creamy Caesar-style dressing | Coating | Approximately 15 ml distributed over leaves | 1.0 | 15 g | 470 | 71 kcal |
| Cooked broccoli | 14% | 86 cm² × 2 cm = 172 ml | 0.60 | 103 g | 35 | 36 kcal |
| Breaded fried chicken pieces | 25% | 154 cm² × 1.4 cm = 216 ml | 0.95 | 205 g | 270 | 554 kcal |
| Cheese-and-tomato pizza portion | 9% | 55 cm² × 1.1 cm = 61 ml | 0.90 | 55 g | 280 | 154 kcal |

### 8 — Sanity check
The footprints total **81% of the plate**, consistent with the visible coverage. The estimated total is **470 g and 865 kcal**. Most energy comes from the fried chicken, pizza, and dressing. The partially cropped pizza and uncertain dressing quantity are the main sources of uncertainty.
